patch.value: Self-host bootstrap retry can strand a recovered candidate when the retry itself crashes mid-replacement

Fixing PRRT_kwDOToJT7M68vvUL's heavy-lift companion in PR #240 exposed a residual corner: the explicit recovery consumes the pending publication, so a crash between that recovery and the replacement rename leaves the recovered (possibly stale) candidate sitting untracked at the bundle path with no pending intent left; a later write then refuses the untracked bundle until it is removed by hand. A pending-publication inspection or cancellation seam in the engine would let the script distinguish its own stranded candidate from a foreign untracked file. Engine-side work stays in draft PR #242.
